name: 3ngram
description: 3ngram for Claude Code: a read-only commitment panel over your 3ngram memory.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Read commitments within this 3ngram scope (for example work). Empty reads the project in any scope.

include_unscoped.title: Include unscoped records
include_unscoped.description: Also show this scope's commitments written without a project. Needs a scope. Each one is verified before it is labelled unscoped.

refresh_minutes.title: Refresh interval (minutes)
refresh_minutes.description: How often the panel re-reads in the background. At least 1.

github_evidence.title: GitHub evidence
github_evidence.description: Look up the GitHub issues and pull requests commitments mention, read-only, with the gh CLI.

auto_open.title: Open on start
auto_open.description: Open the panel when a session starts, on a terminal wide enough to dock it.
